gap: No result ChatGPT got states magnet holding force as one comparable number: ESR publishes 1,800 g (about 17.7 N) for the Geo Wallet Boost and 3,200 g (about 31.4 N) for the Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand, Apple and Smartish publish no figure, and ESR's own 'four times stronger than FineWoven' claim puts Apple's wallet at about 800 g (about 7.8 N).
standout_why: I opened Macworld's iPhone 17 cases page, which ChatGPT cited. The part I could read has no wallet cases and no magnet figures. I could not open Good Housekeeping (cited), Best Products or Wired (fetch blocked). I did not try Wirecutter (cited, through a proxy) or Esquire, Travel + Leisure and GearLark. So 'new' is checked only against Macworld. The ChatGPT answers themselves use only qualitative words like 'secure'. The only place I found the 4x FineWoven comparison is 9to5Mac (not in ChatGPT's results), and it quotes ESR's claim without measuring it.
decides: This backs the detachable-wallet pick over Apple's FineWoven and Smartish Side Hustle: the ESR wallets are the only ones with a published hold figure, and they hold 4 to 5 cards against Apple's 3. ESR's Geo Wallet Boost and both stand models also have their own Find My module that tracks in real time (ESR's wording). Apple's wallet gives only a last known location once it comes off. The one-piece pick (Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1) doesn't change, because it has no magnet. Two fixes for our page: (1) the 'Geo Wallet Stand (HaloLock)' row has no published force, and the store listing doesn't say whether it fits cards and cash or cards only, while ESR's 'Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand' lists 3,200 g, five cards plus cash and Find My at $46.99. Consider switching rows, but first settle whether the 5-card ESR has Find My: ESR's store says yes, and 9to5Mac's review of an ESR 5-card wallet says no. (2) The Mujjo row's URL now returns a 301 redirect to troubadourgoods.com, and that product page would not load, so the Mujjo row needs re-sourcing.

findings.source_title: MagSafe Monday: Is the ESR 5-card wallet better than Apple's FineWoven wallet? – 9to5Mac (Bradley Chambers, 2026-03-30)
findings.note: Chambers writes 'ESR claims it has 3,200 g of holding force' and calls it 'four times stronger than Apple's FineWoven MagSafe wallet'. That is a maker claim, not a measurement. 3,200 / 4 = 800 g. Chambers says FineWoven holds 3 cards and the ESR holds up to five. He also says the ESR 'is missing … Find My support', which conflicts with ESR's own store listing for the 3,200 g Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand.
